seriesTitle: Are You Afraid of the Dark?

episodes.title: Part One: Submitted for Approval
episodes.summary: Tormented by a series of scary nightmares, the new girl in school feels isolated and out of place until a mysterious group invites her to join their ranks. All she has to do is tell a truly terrifying story.

episodes.title: Part Two: Opening Night
episodes.summary: When a friend's disappearance seems to be linked to Rachel's story, the Midnight Society decides to attend the Carnival of Doom. Is it the same carnival from her nightmares? And if so... how could that be possible?

episodes.title: Part Three: Destroy All Tophats
episodes.summary: With her friends' lives at stake, Rachel decides to take charge and end Mr. Tophat's reign of terror. Will this story have a happy ending... or is the Midnight Society doomed?

episodes.title: The Tale of the Haunted Wood
episodes.summary: Five kids investigate the disappearance of their friend, the leader of The Midnight Society whose fate may be tied to a mysterious curse that haunts their seaside town.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Night Frights
episodes.summary: As the Midnight Society digs deeper into the mystery, they discover themselves haunted by an evil entity known as the Shadowman.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Phantom Light
episodes.summary: The Midnight Society seeks help from an unlikely source - the ghost of someone who may know how the curse was created a generation earlier.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Danse Macabre
episodes.summary: On the eve of the school dance, the Midnight Society wrestles with the possibility that evil still lurks among them and the nightmare is far from over.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Midnight Magic
episodes.summary: With dark forces growing stronger and the curse claiming another victim, a shattered Midnight Society prepares to fight back against the Shadowman.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Darkhouse
episodes.summary: Luke gets help from the beyond to uncover more supernatural secrets, and devises a bold plan to finally end the curse of the shadows.

episodes.title: The Tale of Room 13
episodes.summary: After checking into a hotel on a resort island, four best friends get more than they bargained for and encounter genuine terror locked away in one of the rooms.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Teen Spirit
episodes.summary: As the kids try to enjoy summer vacation, they are pulled back into the mystery of the island's ghosts, ultimately leading them to a terrifying and shocking revelation.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Looking Glass
episodes.summary: After unleashing an evil ghost from the mirror, the kids face a night of terrors in the haunted hotel -- where they must uncover the history of the island and hatch a plan to survive.

episodes.title: The Tale of the Other Side
episodes.summary: Caught in a battle between the living and the dead, a shattered Midnight Society must harness the power of friendship to piece itself together and restore peace to Ghost Island.
